messages:
Maria G: hey team — onboarding Acme's enterprise eval. They want: hosted API keys with a hard spend cap ($2k), a Dedicated GPU pool for throughput testing, and a VPC/private control plane for data residency. Need steps + ETA. Also they have a security questionnaire asking for KMS/HSM details. Can we provision a billing org/project and seed free credits? @Alex C @Sam K

Alex C: @Maria G yep. High-level flow: create billing org -> create project under org -> seed credits and set spend cap/quota -> generate ephemeral API keys for the project -> kick off Dedicated/VPC requests. Dedicated lead time depends on region.

Alex C: Quick request template (paste into the ticket):

```json
{
  "org_name": "Acme Corp - Eval",
  "project_id": "acme-eval-2026",
  "free_credits_usd": "2000",
  "spend_cap_usd": "2000",
  "quota_per_minute": "60",
  "ephemeral_key_ttl_days": "7"
}
```

Alex C: Notes: use ephemeral keys for the POC (TTL 7d). If they need longer, we can create refresh tokens but prefer rotating keys. For VPC/private control plane we need customer subnet CIDR, allowed egress CIDRs, and an SRE contact.

Sam K: FYI on Dedicated: we'll need GPU SKU (e.g., A10G or H100), desired pool size, and expected QPS + peak sequence length. Typical lead time: ~3-5 business days for capacity in common regions, longer for uncommon SKUs.

Sam K: Terraform snippet for requesting a pool (internal API):

```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "acme_poc" {
  region        = "us-west-2"
  instance_type = "A10G"
  count         = 2
  autoscale     = true
}
```

Sam K: Also: we'll need IP allowlist entries for their egress NAT and the on-prem CIDR for peering. Expect ~72h for peering + firewall rules after we have CIDRs and contacts.

Jamie P: For billing: we can seed credits as a one-time invoice credit against the new org. If they'd like automatic billing after credits, we need a PO number + billing contact.

Jamie P: Spend cap behavior: when spend cap is set at $2000 it will halt new requests when the credit is exhausted (enforced at project level). If they want softer limits, use per-minute quotas instead. Please tag the project with `sales-poc` and the customer account id.

provision-bot: ticket RDW-4521 created for org+project creation and initial crediting. Assignee: Alex C. ETA: org creation (1 business day), Dedicated request (3 business days), VPC/private setup (5 business days) — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-4521

Maria G: perfect — I'll send the customer the template and the SQ answers. @Alex C can you own the Dedicated request? @Sam K can you confirm GPU SKU availability for us-west-2 and estimate cost delta for A10G vs H100? Thanks :thumbsup:

Alex C: I’ll own the Dedicated flow. Will update the Jira with the requested SKU/size.

Sam K: I'll check SKU availability and post numbers in RDW-4521 by EOD.

Maria G: great — keeping this thread as the single source for the POC billing/provision notes. I'll follow up with the customer after RDW-4521 is updated.
